name: mors
title: Mors — talk in Morse
description: One key, one tape. Key your message in dots and dashes and send it to Claude, who reads it as a prompt and does what it says. The window assumes you know Morse: only Doto can help you craft it (read it back, spell a word, the chart, a full controller), and Claude can answer in Morse on the tape.

mors.changed.summary: A word closed, an erase, a clear, or Claude's command changed the message (settled, never mid-letter): {rev, morse, text, letters, words, wpm, unit, view, by: human|claude|restore, delta?}

mors.ghost.accept.summary: The human keyed the whole ghost: {rev, text, assisted} (assisted = letters Tab keyed for them)

mors.ghost.reject.summary: The ghost was dropped: {rev, reason: esc|keyed-away|cleared, keyed}

mors.ask.summary: Help asked through Doto: {kind: spell|check|free, question, morse, text, rev, view, source: menu|form}. spell = the words to show as a ghost; check = read what was keyed and say so.

mors.mode.summary: One of Doto's extras was opened or closed: {view: {controller: key|full, readback, chart}, by: human|claude}

mors.export.summary: "Send to Claude": {label, morse, text, letters, words, wpm, view, reply, ends?, stats}. A handoff: decode it yourself, say what you read, then treat it as the prompt and answer in the transcript.

mors.snapshot.summary: Answer to the mors.snapshot command (re = command id): the export payload

mors.suggest.summary: The ghost: letters for the human to key next, shown dim after the message with their characters: {rev, text, reason?}. Up to 60 characters; "" clears.

mors.play.summary: Talk Morse back: blink the lamp, sound the tone and show the symbols on Claude's track: {id?, text?, morse?, wpm?, silent?}. Plays queue; {text: ""} stops. Ends with mors.played.

mors.insert.summary: Append to the human's message, keyed at the current speed unless play:false: {text?, morse?, play?}. Undoable. Ask before inserting more than a word.

mors.erase.summary: Remove from the end: {letters?: n} | {words?: n} | {all: true}. Undoable.

mors.reveal.summary: Doto's extras: {controller?: key|full, readback?: bool, chart?: bool}; only the keys given change

mors.set.summary: Speed and sound: {wpm?: 3..30 | unit?: 40..400 ms, auto?: bool, sound?: bool}

mors.load.summary: Restore a message (the resume command): {morse, wpm?, view?, reply?, ghost?}. Silent except one mors.changed {by: "restore"}.

mors.snapshot.summary: Ask the window for its state; it replies with a mors.snapshot event
